title: Mach-O universal (fat) binary signature
summary: A Mach-O universal (fat) binary begins with the magic 0xCAFEBABE (big-endian) followed by the number of architectures (nfat_arch), then an array of fat_arch structures (cputype, cpusubtype, offset, size, align).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Each fat_arch: cputype (4), cpusubtype (4), offset (4/8), size (4/8), align (4).
Universal binaries contain multiple Mach-O slices (e.g., x86_64 + arm64) for cross-architecture support.
Also used by Java class files (same magic) - distinguished by context.
